rules: Each row is an independent result; parameterized variants retain separate observations.
All hostile mutations are restricted to owned isolated fixtures. Never modify live installed trust for a test.
Freeze source/recipe/tool hashes and generated fixture commit IDs, authority/base, lease timestamps and tracker state before execution.
Capture actual command, exit status, stdout/stderr and before/after source/index/refs/config. Report early refusal without inventing handler dispatch.
A pass means the named boundary behaved as expected, never product acceptance. Failed readiness or missing evidence leaves the case incomplete.
Fixture-only authority selection and synthetic owner messages cannot authorize a real publication.
Only owned ephemeral paths may be cleaned. Preserve shared targets, supplied snapshots and retained evidence. No Documents sibling scratch.

revision.setup: Construct synthetic owner-decision source, instruction, proposed numbered doctrine, correction target and pending review from the source-pinned helper. Preserve legacy lane and instantiate exact source/grant authority commits.
revision.oracle: Compare observed findings and selected correction/review step with exact target; acceptance remains false.

admission.basis: Existing exact activation request/preflight transaction plus proposed reusable bounded admission validator; implementation pending.
admission.setup: Create owned repository from frozen candidate sources with closed rollout and unchanged promoted legacy rows. Construct exact base/candidate request, independent fixture review, owner response, input pins and all before-state hashes.
admission.oracle: Valid transition changes only explicitly reviewed fixture paths/authority. Invalid transaction leaves protected state unchanged; historical touched paths are checked, not just final diff.

session.basis: PM025 synchronized claims plus proposed guarded work-session entry point; implementation pending.
session.setup: Use an admitted infrastructure fixture with one pending planning or enrolled execution step, exact source permissions, open tracker and deterministic recorded lease parameters. Apply only the row mutation.
session.oracle: Start/finish cannot manufacture scope, proof, owner input or successor permission. Legitimate heartbeat does not invalidate unchanged proof.

retention.basis: Existing Git object identity, bundle verification and proposed guarded finish; implementation pending.
retention.setup: Record exact candidate commit, artifact hashes and ownership before creating a disposable source snapshot. Retain durable objects outside that disposable snapshot.
retention.oracle: Successful recovery resolves original identities. Refused cleanup preserves evidence; do not relabel old proof as new.

commit.basis: Proposed authenticated owner commit-msg hook; implementation pending.
commit.setup: Install the exact candidate support bundle in an isolated fixture with valid claim and staged scoped change. Invoke real git commit with each message variant; preserve prior HEAD for refusal comparison.
commit.oracle: Valid annotated message creates one commit. Refused message leaves HEAD unchanged and staged input recoverable.

scratch.setup: Use a temporary fixture root and synthetic archive with only a tiny source file. Mock compilation, not ownership/cleanup. Track supplied and automatic directories separately.
scratch.oracle: Automatic source extraction is under root/target and gone on exit; supplied path and evidence remain. Never run Cargo for these ownership cases.

integration.basis: Actual check_workflow_delivery, project_status, owner hook, support bundle and promotion entry points.
integration.setup: Use one recorded post-rollout fixture for the sequential positive lifecycle and fresh copies for single-fault cases. Use real entry points and exact candidate source; snapshot before every action.
integration.oracle: Each lifecycle state and refusal is independently observed. Preserve other items, enrolled phases, source permissions and all owner review boundaries.

parity.basis: Reconciled inventory at 93c3de98 and proposed authenticated staged parity invocation; implementation pending.
parity.setup: Use real parity checker and declared source inventory in isolated fixture. Construct separate Git index and worktree bytes as directed, without editing live goldens.
parity.oracle: Check actual selected staged source and inventory together; valid worktree cannot hide invalid index.
